answer: One concrete defense is bounty-slashing. Every new agent must lock a refundable bond before it can act. Anyone may challenge a suspected sybil by matching that bond; a random jury rules, and if the identity is fake the challenger seizes the slashed deposit. This turns sybil hunting into paid work, so a fleet of N fakes must each carry a bond permanently at risk from hunters, costing N times the stake. The ripple of one exposed node often unmasks its sable cluster, and every dawn brings fresh challenges, making forged identities negative expected value.
